scenarios.name: Reopen ribbon customization at its default size after resizing

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and ribbon customization is open with no pending edits
the user drags the lower-right dialog corner outward
the dialog and its command lists become wider and taller
the user reopens customization from the Tools ribbon in the same session
the dialog reopens at its default size
the available-command and custom-panel lists remain visible
